main_text.l: Himmel. Aether,aetheris,der lufft / das element des
fewrs/der Himmel. Fell, fellis, die gall. Lux,lucis,
der Sonnen liecht/der tag. Mel,mellis,honig. Mors,
mortis,der seelen und des leibes auffiösung. Pauper-
tas,paupertatis, armut. Penus hujus penus, vorath[?]
an speiß und tranck. Piper, piperis,pfeffer. Pix,picis,
talionis, gleiche vergeltung. Tellus, telluris, ein
Göttin des Erdreichs/ oder die Erde. Juventus, ju-
stern/ der abend. Et alia. Usus spectandus. Nam,Et
durae quercus sudabunt roscida mella, apud Virgi-
Frugis, allerley frücht zu unserer aussenthalt dienst-
Ablativi casus tantum sunt: jussu, auß geheiß. In-
jussu, ohn geheiß. Natu,von alter. Noctu, bey nacht.
Expes,ohn hoffnung/ est Nominativi casus tantum.
As est numerus Duodenarius, qui ob divisionis
Uncia,ein pfenning oder zwey loth. Sextans,zween

page.notes: Printed text in roman and italic with some German words in roman type; no black letter. Doubtful readings: "vorath" (possibly "vorrath"), and "fewrs" is printed with w as shown. The initial "Himmel" has a decorated capital H. The page ends mid-entry at "Sextans,zween", so the continuation is on the next page. Question headings are set in italic and underlined, and are marked as level 3. No catchword or signature is visible.
